definitions.explanation: A person who writes novels or fiction as a profession or creative pursuit.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{小説家|しょうせつか}だ。
{小説家|しょうせつか}になるのが{夢|ゆめ}です。
examples.english: My dream is to become a novelist.

examples.japanese: この{小説家|しょうせつか}の{作品|さくひん}は{全部|ぜんぶ}{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I've read all the works of this novelist.

notes:
{小説家|しょうせつか} combines {小説|しょうせつ} (novel) + {家|か} (professional suffix).

RELATED ～{家|か} PROFESSIONS:
- {作家|さっか} (writer, author)
- {画家|がか} (painter)
- {音楽家|おんがくか} (musician)
- {漫画家|まんがか} (manga artist)
- {専門家|せんもんか} (specialist, expert)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小説家|しょうせつか}: novelist (writes novels specifically)
- {作家|さっか}: writer, author (broader term)
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: author (of a specific work)

USAGE NOTES:
- The ～{家|か} suffix indicates someone who specializes in or practices something professionally
